Subject Coverage

JPSA is intended to cover research across the physical sciences, including theoretical physics, applied physics, condensed matter physics, materials physics, optics and photonics, computational physics, nuclear and particle physics, and interdisciplinary physical sciences.

Read Aims and Scope →

Publication and Access

The declared publication frequency is monthly. The journal's stated access model is subscription. Detailed access arrangements, subscription terms and any applicable charges must be published before the relevant services are offered.
